_about: 师父传印 (rules/seals.mjs; Hanli 2026-11-10: 「结印是亮点」 · 「可以，按这个做」): the master passes on ONE seal a week, in three steps — 看 (his demonstration), 跟 (gesture by gesture), 考 (the whole seal against the clock) — and the learned seals are kept in the 印谱 (the save's `seals.book`: id, when, and `hp`, mastery in half-points). Every number the player meets is declared here: `week.days` the wait between two lessons; `lesson.own` and `drill.own` the pay, in small games at the layer he stands on (the unit form of gongke.json `own` and happenings.json `variety.own`, paid by rules/playpay.mjs playGrant through the task's `own`); `mastery` the half-point each clean cast adds and the levels it opens (生 · 熟 · 精) with the strength each lends (`power`, a share added to the spell where a tower-defence kit resolves it — games/shoulu, shouqiang and sadoushou read it; a kit played without it, the proof bots, resolves exactly as before, so mastery only ever helps); `exam` the clock: `watch` ms a figure of the demonstration stands, `hands` · `tap` the 考's (and a drill's chain, scaled by its length) time limit, `strikes` the time outs after which a camera player is offered 「改用点选」. A cast made with the hands at the lens adds `cast.hands` half-points, a tapped one `cast.tap` (half as many: Hanli's hard rule, the lesson is finishable without a camera and counts half). Mastery never drops: half-points only grow.

step._about: The chain errand 九节菖蒲's lesson step (quests/guan.json guan-jiujie-4a): the seals the 看炉 board (守炉, jieyin.json hosts.shoulu.moves) can use. The first of them he has not learned is taught — the weekly wait does not hold him back, and the lesson counts as the week's, so the clock starts from it — else the step is a drill of the seals he has.

_book: The seals he can be taught, in the order the master teaches them (the book's, 06-第六回: 火弹、冰锥、金刃、木藤、土墙, the flying sword first). Each is a spell some tower-defence kit resolves, so its 威力 is true: `move` the kit move ids it strengthens (shoulu's hosts.shoulu.moves, shouqiang's jieyin.moves, sadoushou's jieyinSets); `figures` its gestures, ids of jieyin.json `seals` — all one-hand, the same on a phone and a Mac — the last the spell's 文; `from` the gate the kits use (marks the save must hold, none: from the start); `seed` the marks that say the story's own 讲堂 lesson (qianye-qiajue) already taught it: an old save holding one has it learned at 生, undated (so the week's wait never counts from it).

does.zh: 剑诀一戳，飞剑直取最近的妖兽
does.en: Jab the sword seal: a flying sword takes the nearest beast

line.zh: 摊开手，再并起两指——剑诀。一指出去，剑便跟着去。
line.en: Open the hand, then bring two fingers together: the sword seal. Where the finger goes, the sword follows.

does.zh: 掐午文，扣拳，一推：火弹炸在妖兽身上
does.en: Press Wu, close the fist, push: a fire shot bursts on the beast

line.zh: 午在南，南是火。掐住中指尖，火便攒在手里。
line.en: Wu is south, and south is fire. Press the middle fingertip and the fire gathers in your hand.

does.zh: 掐子文，扣拳，一推：冰锥扎住妖兽，叫它慢下来
does.en: Press Zi, close the fist, push: an ice needle pins the beast and slows it

line.zh: 子在北，北是水。拇指横过掌心，水气才肯凝。
line.en: Zi is north, and north is water. Lay the thumb across the palm and the water will set.

does.zh: 掐酉文，扣拳，一推：金刃横扫一排妖兽
does.en: Press You, close the fist, push: a metal blade sweeps a row of beasts

line.zh: 酉在西，西是金。按住小指下面那一节，金才出刃。
line.en: You is west, and west is metal. Press the joint under the little fingertip and the blade comes out.

does.zh: 掐卯文，扣拳，一推：木藤缠住妖兽，叫它挪不动步
does.en: Press Mao, close the fist, push: a wood vine roots the beast where it stands

line.zh: 卯在东，东是木。拇指按在食指中节，木才抽条。
line.en: Mao is east, and east is wood. Press the thumb on the index's middle joint and the wood puts out shoots.

does.zh: 掐玉清诀，扣拳，一推：土墙立起，把妖兽推开
does.en: Press Jade Clarity, close the fist, push: an earth wall rises and shoves the beasts back

line.zh: 土居当中。按在中指中节，玉清诀一成，地便立起来。
line.en: Earth keeps the middle. Press the middle finger's middle joint; when Jade Clarity is made the ground stands up.

en.watchLine: Watch the master make it once.
en.followLine: Follow, holding each gesture a moment.
en.examLine: Make it whole, against the clock.
en.tapExam: Tap them in order, against the clock.
en.cameraTip: With the camera on, it counts double.
en.passed: Passed. {name} is in your seal book.
en.noLesson: The master has nothing to teach today.
en.cardHead: The master passes on a seal
